# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-261#map-launch-and-session-test-data

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision:** SEED-261#map-launch-and-session-test-data (`.planning/seeds/SEED-261-share-domain-test-data.md`, anchor `map-launch-and-session-test-data`), plan `.planning/slice-plans/534-map-launch-and-session-test-data/PLAN.md`, completed work at `4f35c2175f4299da35454d4d90a3f7f1ecc63c68`.
- **Promise (key example 1):** Two projects each keep an execution launch of one story, one marked Done yesterday. When the sessions sidebar loads, Recently done lists only the Done one, under its project; the open one stays among open sessions.
- **Fixture:** `dashboard/tests/sessions/recently-done-sessions-sidebar-projects.spec.ts:19`, the dedicated key example 1 case from slice 2. Both records are built by `makeMe.aLaunchRecord` (doughnut: `.executing(...).inClaudeSession(...).launchedAt(daysAgo(2)).markedDoneAt(retainedDoneAt())`; pygardon: same without `markedDoneAt`, with a listed Claude session) and written through the one store owner `keepLaunchStore` (`dashboard/tests/support/launchStore.ts`).
- **Fault:** `dashboard/src/agentLaunch.ts`, `doneSessionsOf`, changed `.filter((record) => record.doneAt !== undefined)` to `.filter((record) => record !== undefined)`, so Recently done would list every kept launch, including open ones. Fixture and assertions untouched.
- **Maintained assertion:** `await expect(shown.entries).toHaveCount(1);` (line 67), backed by line 68 (`not.toContainText("Pygardon story still open")`).
- **Run observations:**
  - Baseline (scratch worktree at the revision, clean `git status`, after `node scripts/setup-native.mjs npm` and `check`): `npm run test:dashboard -- tests/sessions/recently-done-sessions-sidebar-projects.spec.ts --reporter=list` with `NO_COLOR`, `FORCE_COLOR` and `GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES` unset and Homebrew first on `PATH`: 1 passed (test 3.8s, run 7.1s), so it exercised the selected test.
  - Faulted: 1 failed (8.3s). The run passed line 65 (the open Pygardon entry is still among open sessions, so setup and the path were reached) and failed at line 67: Recently done entries locator "Expected: 1, Received: 2" (resolved to 2 elements 14 times). This shows the changed behavior on the intended path: the open record was listed in Recently done, and the intended assertion caught it.
  - Restored: the fault was applied under a shell `trap` that copied back the saved original on exit. Afterward `git diff --stat` was empty and `git status --porcelain` matched the empty pre-probe state (test-results output is ignored). The same command passed again (1 passed, test 3.2s, run 4.2s).
- **Scratch checkout:** `git worktree add --detach /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/60be1b19/tmp/intent-scratch 4f35c2175...`, removed with `git worktree remove --force`. It no longer appears in `git worktree list`, and the directory is gone. The execution checkout was not edited.

## Cost

- **Test runtime.** Measured by the Playwright runner: baseline 7.1 s, faulted run about 8.3 s test time plus the 5 s assertion timeout (whole-run total not printed), restored 4.2 s. Native setup (`setup-native npm` + `check`) is not included.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no human took part in this check, and no separate measure of human time was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable: no separately supported measure (token or tool-call accounting) was available to this agent.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 81991 ms (measured), from 1794161725270 to 1794161807261 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
